user.title: SwitchBot E-Ink Home Dashboard
user.description: Sign in with your SwitchBot account. The password is stored in Home Assistant: it is used to renew the session on its own when the token expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {username} is no longer valid and the automatic renewal failed. Enter the password: from now on it is stored and the renewal is automatic.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the SwitchBot service. Try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.no_devices_found: No e-ink panel found on this account.
abort.account_mismatch: This account does not own the configured panel. Sign in with the account used originally.

refresh.name: Refresh the dashboard
refresh.description: Rebuilds the agenda and publishes it to the panel, even if nothing changed.
